title: Onomappu — 気持ちの擬音語 (Sound Words for Emotions)
description: From Onomappu. This episode explores Japanese sound-symbolic words (擬情語) that express emotional and physical states: ドキドキ (heart pounding), ワクワク (excited anticipation), イライラ (irritated), ぐったり (exhausted), もやもや (vague unease). These high-frequency words appear constantly in modern Japanese speech, manga, and social media.
creator: Onomappu (Hitoki)
